summary:
[  edit  ]
The Count  CHOP  counts the number of times a channel crosses a trigger or release threshold. It operates in either static or realtime (" Cook  to Current  Frame ") mode.
The trigger value by default is 0, so the count occurs when the input goes from below (or equal to) 0 to a value that is greater than zero.
Crossing the trigger threshold (increasing past the trigger level) creates a trigger event. Similarly, crossing the release threshold (decreasing past the release level) creates a release event. Operations may also be performed while the input remain above or below the trigger or release levels. On each event, the count may be increased or decreased by 1 or the time, or reset to zero. The time per sample varies with the sample rate (i.e. for 100 samples/second, the time for each sample would be 1/100th of a second).
The optional second input is a reset input. The first channel is interpreted as a channel containing reset pulses. Whenever this channel is non-zero, the count for all channels is reset.
The third input is labeled "Increment Value". It allows you to specify a value other than the default +-1 to count. If you want to count by Fives, then put a channel with a value of 5 in this input. It will increment by 5 each count, or by 5 per second depending on the On / Off menus on the second page.

parameters.label: Release = Trigger Threshold
parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: If on, the trigger threshold is also used as the release threshold.

parameters.label: Trigger Threshold
parameters.name: threshup
parameters.description: The channel level that must be exceeded in order to trigger a count.

parameters.label: Release Threshold
parameters.name: threshdown
parameters.description: A release count is triggered when the channel level drops below this threshold.

parameters.label: Re-Trigger Delay
parameters.name: retrigger
parameters.description: The amount of time after a trigger point that a new trigger may occur.

parameters.label: Trigger On
parameters.name: triggeron
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines whether a trigger occurs on an increasing slope or decreasing slope when passing the trigger threshold. A release will occur on the opposite slope.

parameters.label: Limit
parameters.name: output
parameters.description: ⊞  - Select limit options such as loop and/or clamp from the menu. The value will remain in the range from Min to Max.

parameters.label: Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: No limits.

parameters.label: Loop Min/Max
parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Will cycle in a loop between the values given by Limit Minimum / Maximum.

parameters.label: Clamp Min/Max
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Clamp will hold the count value at the maximum/minimum value if it goes above or below the limits.

parameters.label: Loop Min, Clamp Max
parameters.name: lc
parameters.description: Will loop the count back between the limits by shifting the count to the maximum limit.

parameters.label: Clamp Min, Loop Max
parameters.name: cl
parameters.description: Will loop the count back between the limits by shifting the count to the minimum limit.

parameters.label: Zigzag Min/Max
parameters.name: zigzag
parameters.description: Will zig-zag the count back and forth between the minimum and maximum limit.

parameters.label: Limit Minimum
parameters.name: limitmin
parameters.description: The minimum allowed count number.

parameters.label: Limit Maximum
parameters.name: limitmax
parameters.description: The maximum allowed count number.

parameters.label: Off to On
parameters.name: offtoon
parameters.description: ⊞  - The operation to perform when a trigger event (off to on) occurs.

parameters.label: While On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: ⊞  - The operation to perform while the input remains triggered (on).

parameters.label: On to Off
parameters.name: ontooff
parameters.description: ⊞  - The operation to perform when a release event (on to off) occurs.

parameters.label: While Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: ⊞  - The operation to perform while the input is not triggered (off).

parameters.label: Reset Condition
parameters.name: resetcondition
parameters.description: ⊞  - This menu determines how the Reset input triggers a reset of the channel(s).

parameters.label: Off to On
parameters.name: offtoon
parameters.description: Channels are reset when the Reset input goes off to on.

parameters.label: While On
parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Channels are reset when the Reset input goes on. The channel will hold the reset value until the input turns off.

parameters.label: On to Off
parameters.name: ontooff
parameters.description: Channels are reset when the Reset input goes on to off.

parameters.label: While Off
parameters.name: off
parameters.description: Channels are reset when the Reset input goes off. The channel will hold the reset value until the input turns on.

parameters.label: Reset Value
parameters.name: resetvalue
parameters.description: The channel(s) is set to this value when reset.

parameters.label: Reset
parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: When On resets the channel(s) to the Reset Value. The Count  CHOP  will only begin counting again when Reset is Off.

parameters.label: Reset  Pulse
parameters.name: resetpulse
parameters.description: Instantly resets the channel(s) to the Reset Value.

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page. See  Pattern Matching .

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At First Input's Rate
parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Use rate of first input to resample others.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate
parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Resample to the highest sample rate.

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate
parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ
parameters.name: err
parameters.description: Doesn't accept conflicting sample rates.

parameters.label: Export  Method
